sinopsis.es: Lo último de John Madden, nominado al Oscar por Shakespeare in Love, reúne a Laura Linney, nominada al Oscar por The Savages, y a Rhys Ifans (Mother Couch) como dos desconocidos cuyas vidas se enredan cuando a ambos les diagnostican párkinson.
sinopsis.en: The latest from Oscar-nominated director John Madden (Shakespeare in Love) stars Oscar nominee Laura Linney (TIFF ’08’s The Savages) and Rhys Ifans (TIFF ’23’s Mother Couch) as strangers whose lives become entwined when both are diagnosed with Parkinson disease.
